title: The Unquiet Cipher Revisited
author: Silas Iversen
blurb: Ada Iversen, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
